Class Lobby

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.server.Lobby
public class Lobby extends Object
Represents a game lobby waiting for players before a match starts.

A lobby has a fixed capacity; once all slots are filled (checkFullLobby() returns true), the MatchManager starts the match by calling buildPlayers().
